title: Development of deep learning-based detecting systems for pathologic myopia using retinal fundus images.
summary: Deep-learning systems classified pathological myopia and myopic macular lesions from color fundus images using the META-PM scheme. The study reports test and external-validation performance comparable to general ophthalmologists and retinal specialists.
ai_technology: Deep-learning image classifiers for pathological myopia and myopic macular lesions.
